content.title: Planning Commission
content.summary: The Planning Commission acts as an advisory body to the City Council, reviewing various development proposals and creating a long-range comprehensive plan. Meetings are held at 6:15 pm on the first and third Wednesdays of each month at City Hall, where public comments can be made in person, by mail, or through an online form. The commission consists of seven members serving four-year terms, and recruitment for vacancies will begin in December.
content.body:
## Overview

The Planning Commission serves as an advisory body to the City Council. The commission reviews annexations, rezonings, subdivisions, and planned unit developments, and formulates a long-range comprehensive plan.

## Meeting Information

- 6:15 pm
- 1st and 3rd Wednesdays of every month
- Council Chambers  
  City Hall  
  8101 Ralston Road

### Public Comment

1. [form](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_0)
2. [mail](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_1)
3. [In person](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_2)

1. [form](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_0)

Public comments can be submitted by [**completing this form**](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/64351).

1. [mail](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_1)

Comments can be sent via mail to:

Planning Commission  
8101 Ralston Road  
Arvada CO 80001

1. [In person](#tabd853f768-9b82-4e7b-97af-c1efd7d725f1_2)

Members of the public are welcome to make public comment during meetings. However, public comment is only allowed during scheduled times on the agenda or during a public hearing. There are multiple ways to make comments on a specific public hearing or make a general comment to the Commission.

## Board Details

- 7 members
- 4 year terms
- Compensation: $100 per meeting
- Must be a resident of Arvada to serve

## Interested in Joining the Planning Commission?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
